title: Every layout got a glow-up — plus two new ones
summary: Your whole profile now matches the layout you pick, from the top of the page to the comments.
changes: New **Infected** layout (free): a biohazard quarantine file with a scanner around your avatar, a glitching name and your views as the infection level
New **Holo Card** layout (Infected Plus): your profile as a holographic trading card that tilts and shines as you move
The whole page now matches your layout — widgets, Discord and Spotify cards, skills, projects and comments
Animated backgrounds for every layout: starfields, CRT scanlines, nebulas, a honeycomb and more
**Modern** got a makeover: aurora background, a glowing ring around your avatar and smoother cards
